g7_warnings.warning: The fire score gives no fitted or elicited values for k_1 and k_2, no scale reconciliation, and no validation that the weighted score measures operational severity.
The printed five-piece diffraction-loss relation has overlapping intervals and incomplete semantics; it is preserved rather than silently repaired.
The stated average altitude of 551.8 km is almost certainly a metre/kilometre unit error and cannot be used literally.
The three-airframe claim lacks a complete endurance, travel, charging, overlap, reserve, failure, and launch timeline.
The two repeater-count branches both include d_m = 13.5 km, so the equality case is contradictory.
The EOC and repeater genetic algorithms omit population size, encoding bounds, crossover and mutation rates, stopping rule, seeds, and repeated-run stability.
The 24-repeater, 30-SSA result lacks frozen inputs, candidate sets, solver traces, intermediate coverage states, and an exact or heuristic baseline.
The LSTM supplies no architecture, hyperparameters, train/validation split, baseline comparison, seed, residual diagnostics, uncertainty, or code.
The regression uses only 2019-2020 fire observations, omits holdout scoring and uncertainty, and does not control for fuel, wind, rainfall, ignition, suppression, or spatial dependence.
Uniform 1.0884 spatial expansion preserves source shape and ignores spread direction, fuel, weather, barriers, suppression, ignition, and correlated uncertainty.
The printed SSA cost increase of 18,000 AUD conflicts with 18 additional drones at 10,000 AUD each; 180,000 AUD is required for the stated 210,000 AUD total increase.
The EOC-near-high-mountain rationale is unclear, and the terrain-dependent repeater-range relation has an ambiguous piecewise layout and incomplete units.
The sixteen repeater coordinates form an unusually regular sequence and are not supported by candidate data, objective values, feasibility traces, or independent radio measurements.
Sensitivity varies only flight altitude from 3.6 to 4.4 km and does not test model structure, fire inputs, weights, GA randomness, schedules, costs, interactions, or decision-rank stability.
The budget prices only the two drone categories and gives little item-level quotation, lifecycle, staffing, battery, maintenance, training, tax, contingency, or uncertainty justification.
The body reaches Page 21 of 20, and physical pages 24-25 carry Team 2120188 in the header while the paper and signature identify Team 2127300.
